verdict.rationale: Community reports say Fastmail can fetch mail from Gmail and send through it like a mail client, and that its Gmail mail and calendar ingestion works well. That is the product's own way of working an external account from inside Fastmail. The evidence covers only Gmail and comes only from community comments. The 'Logging in to multiple accounts' and 'Import your mail' docs are titles only and describe Fastmail-account switching and one-off migration, not ongoing multi-provider aggregation, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: Microsoft 365 connection, generic IMAP account fetching, first-party documentation of external-account fetch and send, and evidence of a unified view across several connected accounts.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place

citations.quote: you can configure Fastmail to fetch mail from (and send via) Gmail like a mail client.
Gmail integration for ingesting mail and calendars works fantastically.
